Steps Easing Explorer

One function. Four ways to jump. Compare exact boundaries, inspect both sides, and take the CSS — without playing an animation.

03 / Use the CSS

The before flag and inspected p do not change the CSS. This declaration alone does not create an animation.

How to read this tool

N counts input intervals. The output denominator J is N, N−1 for jump-none, or N+1 for jump-both. The trace shows h=floor(p×N), the adjusted step c and J.

Exact boundary 1/3 is not decimal 0.333333. Use boundary mode to land exactly on a jump. At p=0, before=true obeys the unit-domain lower clamp; it is not an extrapolated negative-time value.

CSS aliases start/end and step-start/step-end are explained here only. This tool accepts the four explicit jump positions and always serializes that spelling.

Scope: one interval count, four jump positions, unit progress. No delay, fill, reverse, iteration or keyframe simulation.

Numbers stay in this page. No upload, storage, clipboard API or autoplay. Hiding or leaving the page clears generated results; reload opens defaults.
